e: Euler's number, the base of natural logarithms

A_d: Mass number of the daughter nucleus
E: Total energy of the electron, T + mₑc²
F: Fermi function, the daughter's Coulomb pull on the electron (or push on a positron)
N: Number of electrons per unit energy, the shape of the spectrum
R: Radius where the alpha and the daughter touch, r₀(A_d^⅓ + 4^⅓)
T_1/2: Half life (for alpha decay, the partial alpha half life)
T_alpha: Kinetic energy of the alpha particle
V: Potential energy of the alpha in the daughter's Coulomb field
Z_d: Atomic number of the daughter nucleus
beta: Beta decay: β⁻ gives off an electron, β⁺ a positron
f: Number of times a second the alpha hits the barrier
mu: Reduced mass of the alpha and the daughter
r: Distance of the alpha from the center of the daughter
v: Speed of the alpha inside the nucleus, √(2Q/μ)
